title: exudev build: build with the newest complete Windows SDK when the newest one lacks an import library the link needs
author: Claude-JG
description: setuptools always takes the newest Windows SDK. A Windows update (2026-10-21) left Windows Kits/10/Lib/10.0.26100.0/um/x64 without gdi32.lib, opengl32.lib and shell32.lib, so every build failed at the link with LNK1181. exudev build checks the import libraries setup.py links in the newest SDK; if one is missing, it builds in the environment of vcvarsall.bat for the newest complete SDK (DISTUTILS_USE_SDK, MSSdk) and says so.
releaseNotes: exudev build checks on Windows whether the newest Windows SDK has every import library setup.py links; if not, it builds in the environment of vcvarsall.bat for the newest complete SDK and says so
